title: Architecture Decision Records Policy
description: All significant architectural decisions are recorded as immutable ADRs with full rationale, alternatives considered, and approval chain.

sections.heading: ADR Format
sections.body: Each ADR must include: title, status, context, decision, consequences, alternatives considered, and approval date.

sections.heading: Immutability
sections.body: ADRs are never modified retroactively. Superseding an ADR requires a new ADR that references the superseded record.
